value.rationale: The object is the natural sharp moment profile governing disagreement of coherent posterior probabilities. The result gives the analytic signature of a genuine optimizer-family switch—a first-order cusp—and quantifies the rate at which the sharp high-moment constant approaches its known universal limit. These are structural features of the optimal-value curve, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a recomputation of a table.
